sections.p: Premium Seat Covers makes car seat covers to order. This notice explains what personal information we collect through this website and why.

When you request a quote we collect your name, mobile number with country code, city, car make, model and year, the products and options you choose, an optional message, and whether you agree to marketing messages. We also keep a record of when you gave or withheld that consent. We do not collect payment details on this website.
We use this information to prepare and send you a quotation, to answer questions about your request, and, only if you opt in, to send product updates. We do not sell your information.

If you open a WhatsApp chat from this site, the conversation happens in WhatsApp under its own terms. We contact you on WhatsApp or by phone only for the request you made, or for updates you have agreed to receive.

We keep quote requests for as long as needed to answer them and keep our records. The business owner confirms the exact retention period before launch. You can ask us to delete your request at any time.
You can withdraw marketing consent at any time by messaging us on WhatsApp. Withdrawal takes effect straight away and you will not receive marketing messages after that.
For privacy questions or deletion requests, message us on WhatsApp using the number on the contact page.
This website lets you browse seat covers, see public list prices and request a quotation. Submitting the request does not place an order.
Prices are list prices in Indian rupees and may change. Your final quotation depends on your vehicle, material, colour and quantity, and is confirmed by us in writing.
A quote request is an enquiry. An order exists only after you confirm a quotation we have sent you and we accept it. Until then, nothing is final.
Fitment depends on the exact make, model and year. Confirm fitment with us before you order, especially for model years that are not listed.
Colours and images on screen may differ from the finished product because of screen settings and material batches.
To the extent the law allows, our liability for an accepted order is limited to the price of that order.
We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.
